evidence: Carries the 'TX fees and policy' label and modifies mempool policy rules for standardness under -acceptnonstdtxn.
rationale: Allows developers on test networks to submit and relay transactions with non-standard script flags (like OP_SUCCESS or OP_NOPx) through the mempool. While valuable for testing proposed soft forks without requiring out-of-band mining, it is a testnet-only policy capability and reasonably deferrable.
